name: Unattributed
note: Provenance not established. Every file here is on Maki's 15×15 grid and carries NO CC0 metadata stamp — see icons/versatiles/source.json for what that stamp means and why its absence is evidence.

leads.lead: Arrived in commit 5454666 (2026-07-04, 'Add new icons and update existing ones in the icon set'), a batch of 23 replacements that swapped the artwork and dropped the CC0 stamp. Two icons from the same batch — police_officer and seesaw — were later matched to Temaki by path geometry, so the batch may well be Temaki at a version we have not tested, or a set derived from it.
Predate that batch and match no upstream geometry. arrow2 and arrow3 are 16×16, unlike everything else here.

howToResolve: `npm run icons-report` lists what is here. Move a file into its source folder once identified, keeping the upstream filename, and update its sprite entry in scripts/config-sprites.ts.
